evidence.computation: Cooling rejects negative elapsed durations. A complete two-stage schedule checks the first stage within two hours and the sum within six; ambiguous compound timing is withheld.
assumptions: The question supplies supported stage endpoints and incremental elapsed durations for the declared Food Code 2022 timing model.
These computations concern the stated numbers and do not determine whether a specific food is safe.
untrusted: Natural-language stage selection, elapsed-time parsing, and the applicability of the declared rule to the situation.
